We can use the fact that:

d/dx(cos(x)**2) = 2 * cos(x) * (-sin(x)) = -2 * sin(x) * cos(x)

Therefore:

∫ -2 * sin(x) * cos(x) dx = cos(x)**2 + C

<answer>cos(x)**2 + C</answer>
